A09 Infectious gastroenteritis and colitis, unspecified

General ward visiting hours are 4pm to 6pm daily. Masks are mandatory in the ICU and NICU. Billing counter closes at 5pm. Pharmacy stock of Metformin and Amlodipine is replenished every Monday. No patient data is referenced here.
